transport: Real HTTP API; frontend unit tests and production build; no browser
isolation: New Compose project, network, PostgreSQL container and volume

checks.name: New database has no stores, recalls, credentials, inventory or incidents
Fresh production frontend bundle is served
Invalid-token error recovers when token is cleared
Administrator created through public local setup authenticates
Store and all named roles created from scratch
Viewer writes and integration administration are blocked
Scoped store listing hides other stores
Archived official source imported into empty database
Repeat source import does not duplicate recalls
Source history and rejected-record inspection are available
Inventory imports valid rows and identifies invalid line
Repeated inventory import preserves two stock identities
Imported stock automatically creates a matching incident
Missing batch requires review without creating a hold
Inventory search and dashboard reflect imported quantities
Delivery import retains two unconfirmed candidates
Identical document bytes deduplicate across filenames
Original delivery download is byte-for-byte identical
Claim acceptance requires authorized human credentials
Confirmed delivery creates exactly one 24-unit hold
Accepted evidence does not overwrite warehouse batch
Accepted association creates a scoped retrieval hint
Evidence records carry source row, validation and actor
Frozen evidence comparison changes review to affected
Simulation creates no operational decisions or holds
Human resolution retains protective hold
Supplier submissions are idempotent
Contradiction reopens review and preserves the same hold
Stale investigation cannot be marked resolved
Supplier correction preserves both original and superseding evidence
Review assignment records the named operator
Affected held case cannot be closed
Real PDF upload extracts one labelled claim with page provenance
Preserved PDF download matches uploaded bytes
Ordered inventory events reject stale, conflicting and cross-store updates
Higher sequence updates stock successfully
New unresolved companion asks a question without a hold
Store-scoped operator cannot inspect another store incident
Sourced physical observation resolves the unknown batch
Settled unaffected case closes
Closed review can be explicitly reopened
Replay advance is idempotent
Classic three-stage replay completes with held conflict
New replay archives rather than deletes old evidence
Both built-in evaluations execute on the fresh deployment
External labelled evaluations retain expected case counts
Invalid evaluation dataset rejected
Absent model configuration is reported without a provider call
Live event stream delivers persisted progress
Worker heartbeat is healthy with no failed events
App restart preserves decisions, holds and source documents
Production mode blocks unauthenticated reads and credential creation
Named administrator survives production restart
Revoked credential cannot authenticate
Authorized hold release is attributed and does not erase decisions
Cross-origin mutation rejected
Backup restores equal decision/evidence/hold counts with zero orphan links
Backend regression suite passes including fault-injection recovery
Frontend component/unit suite passes

limitations: Archived official recall data and fictional business records only.
External model requests and live official API synchronization disabled.
Browser rendering/clicks and Aiven deployment are not exercised.
Crash injection is exercised by backend regression tests on a separate test database.
cleanup: Isolated containers stopped; test volume retained; original app untouched.
